sentences.en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.
sentences.zh: 我们稍事茶点之后将继续会议。

sentences.en: It's time for some liquid refreshment. Who's going to buy the drinks?
sentences.zh: 是时候喝些饮料了。谁去买饮料呢？

sentences.en: Would you ladies care for some refreshments?
sentences.zh: 女士们想要来点儿小吃吗？

senses.zh: —饮料,点心,茶点(需用复数形式 refreshments)
